text: Assets can be defined in code describing how to produce and update them
quote: An asset definition is a description, in code, of an asset that should exist and how to produce and update that asset.

text: Scaffold a new Dagster project using the official create-dagster CLI
quote: you can scaffold a new project with the create-dagster CLI (recommended)

text: Asset checks can validate null values, schema conformance, and data freshness
quote:
Ensure a particular column doesn't contain null values
*   Verify that a tabular asset adheres to a specified schema
*   Check if an asset's data needs refreshing

text: Schedules let you run jobs automatically at set intervals
quote: Schedules enable automated execution of jobs at specified intervals.

text: Sensors trigger actions in response to internal or external events
quote: Sensors enable you to take action in response to events that occur either internally within Dagster or in external systems.

text: Declarative Automation launches asset executions based on asset status and dependency information
quote: Declarative Automation is a framework that uses information about the status of your assets and their dependencies to launch executions of your assets.

text: Run subsets of dbt models, seeds, and snapshots via UI or API as part of the pipeline
quote: Use Dagster's UI or APIs to run subsets of your dbt models, seeds, and snapshots.

text: Airbyte integration lets you trigger and orchestrate Airbyte syncs from Dagster
quote: Using this integration, you can trigger Airbyte syncs and orchestrate your Airbyte connections from within Dagster

text: FivetranAccountComponent represents Fivetran connectors as Dagster assets
quote: provides a FivetranAccountComponent which can be used to easily represent Fivetran connectors as assets in Dagster

text: DltLoadCollectionComponent represents a collection of dlt sources/pipelines as Dagster assets
quote: provides a DltLoadCollectionComponent which can be used to easily represent a collection of dlt sources and pipelines as assets in Dagster

text: Dagster+ alerts notify you of critical deployment events for early issue detection
quote: Dagster+ alerts can notify you of critical events occurring in your deployment so you can catch potential issues early

text: Dagster can be deployed via Docker with dedicated containers for webserver, daemon, and code locations, enabling self-hosting
quote: A typical Dagster Docker deployment includes a several long-running containers: one for the webserver, one for the daemon, and one for each code location.

text: Dagster maintains an AI skill giving coding agents context and patterns for building Dagster projects
quote: Dagster maintains an AI skill that gives coding agents better context and patterns for building Dagster projects.

text: Dagster+ provides an official MCP server for accessing and acting on deployments within an AI session
quote: The Dagster+ MCP server allows you to access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session.

text: Scaffold Dagster Component definitions from the command line via dg scaffold defs
quote: You can scaffold Dagster Component definitions in your project from the command line with the dg scaffold defs command

text: Encapsulate an entire ETL process as a single code-defined Dagster asset
quote: Creating a single Dagster asset that encapsulates the entire Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) process

text: Published tiered pricing plans (e.g. Solo Plan) with free trial for predictable cost estimation
quote: Solo Plan $10 per month Personal projects and simple pipelines ... 30-day free trial

text: Automation condition evaluations explain history-dependent logic by showing the remembered values behind decisions
quote: Automation condition evaluations now explain history-dependent conditions (since, newly_true, newly_missing) by showing the remembered values that determined them

text: Wiping/deleting dynamic partitions now supports multi-partitioned assets in a single action
quote: wiping and deleting dynamic partitions in a single action now also supports multi-partitioned assets that use the dynamic partitions definition as a dimension
